pages.title: Wrench and Goggles
pages.text: Two items you will carry all the time. The **Wrench** changes blocks. The **Engineer's Goggles** show information about them.

pages.title: Wrench
pages.text: Right-click to rotate a component around the face you click. Sneak and right-click to dismantle it. It also moves [#](7A3C9A)[assembled](entry://glossary/assemble)[#]() minecart and train contraptions.

pages.title: Engineer's Goggles
pages.text: Show stress impact, capacity and speed of [#](7A3C9A)[kinetic parts](entry://glossary/kinetic_network)[#](), and the contents of tanks and basins, when you look at them.
Wrenches also toggle connections on [#](7A3C9A)[encased](entry://glossary/encased)[#]() shafts and cogwheels, and open or close the window on fluid tanks.

**Value boxes.** Many machines show a small [#](7A3C9A)[panel](entry://glossary/value_panel)[#]() on a face. Look at it and right-click to change it, or scroll with the mouse wheel to adjust the value. Speed controllers, windmills and gearshifts use these.

**Tooltips.** Hold Shift on any Create item for a summary of what it does and what it needs. Hold W for [#](2E5AAC)[Ponder](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().\
\
Read about stress in [#](2E5AAC)[Stress](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]() and see [#](2E5AAC)[Tools](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().
